pace: Each rider picks a pace; riders break into groups of similar ability
cost: No fee listed; non-members sign the club waiver
visitor_notes: Registration is encouraged: you get a cancellation email if the ride is called off. If you are not a club member, sign the BRBC waiver first. The calendar listed Thursday Oct 1 at 9:30 am; every later Tuesday and Thursday date is at noon.
name: Trevor's Etowah Training Ride
schedule: Tuesdays and Thursdays, 12:00 pm, from Etowah Park. The same out-and-back route into Pisgah Forest each time; riders sort into pace groups.
description: A weekly training ride from Etowah Park, run on the same route every time: out and back to Looking Glass Falls in Pisgah Forest, 38 miles with about 1,050 feet of climbing. A shorter 30-mile option turns around at the Ranger Station. It is a club training series, not a guided ride, so riders split into groups by pace.

pace: 15–17 mph, regroups before and after the Parkway descent
visitor_notes: The shop calls this a common first group ride and has printable directions for people not on Strava. Blue Ridge Parkway closures mean route edits through 2026. Boone Area Cyclists list the same Monday 5:30 ride as the Monday Bistro Ride.
name: Monday Night Ride (Blue Ridge Parkway Viaduct loop)
schedule: Mondays, 5:30 pm, from the top level of the Blowing Rock public parking deck. Warmer months, starting and ending around the time change.

start_location.name: Blowing Rock public parking deck (top level)

description: The classic Viaduct loop out of Blowing Rock, 30 miles with about 2,500 feet of climbing. Most riders climb US 221 and descend the Parkway back to town. The group regroups before the Parkway descent and again near the end. Parkway closures in 2026 change the usual route.
evidence: Boone Bike & Touring's Local Rides page lists the Monday Night Ride at 5:30 pm from the Blowing Rock parking deck and says Parkway closures will force route edits 'throughout 2026'; Boone Area Cyclists' page lists a Monday 5:30 pm ride too. No dated upcoming ride is posted (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

refresh.notes: Page says rides run in the warmer months, around the time change; confirm in late October.

visitor_notes: The shop runs a post-Helene route to avoid the Castle Ford Rd bridge closure. Boone Area Cyclists list a Food Lion Tuesday ride at 5:30 pm on RideWithGPS.
name: Eastside Tuesday Night Ride
schedule: Tuesdays, 5:30 pm, from the Food Lion in Deep Gap. Warmer months, starting and ending around the time change.

start_location.name: Food Lion parking lot

description: The shop's most beginner-friendly group ride. It starts at the Food Lion on 421, runs out toward Todd and Railroad Grade Road, then climbs back to town: 27 miles with about 1,800 feet of climbing. The group regroups often and does not drop anyone.

pace: Leisurely; do one, two or three laps of Greenfield Lake
visitor_notes: Listed in the club's 'All Speeds' category. Sign the club waiver at the ride. Cancelled if the forecast is below 38 F or the roads are wet at the start. The club moved Cargo District Thursday earlier this month, so check the event page for the October start time.
name: Flaming Amy's Burrito Ride
schedule: Wednesdays, 5:30 pm, from Able Insurance next to Flaming Amy's. The club calendar lists it through Oct 21.

start_location.name: Able Insurance (next to Flaming Amy's Burrito Barn)

description: An easy early-evening ride that starts near Flaming Amy's Burrito Barn. The group rolls about two miles through neighborhoods to Greenfield Lake, where each lap is about 4.5 miles. Ride one, two or three laps, then roll back for a burrito.

visitor_notes: Groups are set by turnout. The shop posts weather updates on its social channels. Rental bikes can be reserved ahead.

pace: Social, with options to cut it short
visitor_notes: Beginner and intermediate riders. The shop's Lake Norman store runs it; call that store with questions. Helmets required.
